intro.name: Alexander Saballos
intro.headline: Ingeniero Eléctrico/Electrónico (EI/EiT USA) | Ingeniero de Software | Exalumno HU Walton

about.introduction: This space highlights the systems and projects I've built at the intersection of hardware, software, and infrastructure. I graduated Cum Laude from Harding University with an ABET-accredited B.S. in Electrical Engineering, a minor in Mathematics, and passed the NCEES FE Exam prior to graduation, which enabled me to receive a U.S. EI/EiT license. My work spans embedded systems, power and PCB design, automation, and software development, with an emphasis on clear documentation, long-term maintainability, and practical solutions that hold up outside the lab.
